```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Revised appendix (CJFAS revision).
# - Data, the thermal index, the final model formula, ctl (lmer optimizer),
#   helper functions and the plotting theme come from R/revision_setup.R.
# - Tables and figures made by R/07-R/12 are read from tables/revision/ and
#   plots/revision/, so run those scripts first.
# - Each section is a child file in analysis/appendix-rev/ (_A1 ... _A7).
#   They share this R session, so objects defined here (d, final, helpers)
#   are available in every section.

source(here::here("R", "revision_setup.R"))
library(lme4)
library(splines)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
emm_options(lmer.df = "asymptotic")
theme_set(theme_mfsr(base_size = 10))

# Read a revision table / locate a revision plot
rev_tab  <- function(f) read_csv(here("tables", "revision", f), show_col_types = FALSE)
rev_plot <- function(f) here("plots", "revision", f)
# Default table style
kbl2 <- function(x, ...) {
  kbl(x, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", ...) |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 8)
}
# Day of year -> "28 Aug"
fmt_d <- function(doy) format(fixed_date + doy, "%d %b")

# Final model, refit here for diagnostics and partial-effect plots
# (identical to R/09 F2)
d     <- model_data()
final <- lmer(FINAL_FORMULA, d, REML = TRUE, control = ctl)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo      = FALSE,
  warning   = FALSE,
  message   = FALSE,
  cache     = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.pos   = "H",
  out.extra = ""
)
```
